polozky.nadpis: OGC Announces Publication of the LAZ 1.4 Community Standard
polozky.perex: The Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) is excited to announce the publication of the LAZ 1.4 Community Standard , which defines a lossless compression format for LAS 1.4 point cloud data.
polozky.telo: The Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) is excited to announce the publication of the LAZ 1.4 Community Standard , which defines a lossless compression format for LAS 1.4 point cloud data. LAZ uses lossless compression to reduce the size of a LAS file while maintaining the general structure of the LAS format. The LAZ 1.4 format is based on LAS 1.4, as specified in the LAS Specification 1.4 — R15 by the American Society for Photogrammetry Remote Sensing (ASPRS), also an OGC Community Standard. LAZ compresses the point data block, while other LAS 1.4 structures, such as the header format, remain unchanged, although some header fields are slightly changed.
